song_craft: Voice: śāstra-hammer couplets (NOT quatrain — debate hammers, lyric would dissolve argument). Negation-anaphora across verses (no mark/none/never/nowhere); terminal doctrine words (certain/knower/being/end/blur/mark/nowhere/awareness/as before). Arc: demolition vv1–8 → self-sting v9, which rings v1. L3 already hammer-tight: L4 = L3 verbatim, form recorded, music named — any re-lining would be decoration on a diamond.

lines: As real and unreal carry no mark between them, in own self —
so inert and non-inert carry none. This stands certain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā sadasatām naiva viśeṣo 'sti nijātmani jadājaḍānām apy evaṃ nāsty asāv iti niścayaḥ

verses.craft: Opponent certainty in Vijñānavāda voice; correlative yathā/evam → As/so balance (row 3); end-weight niścayaḥ.
verses.rejected: (a) softening double negation → killed by naiva/nāsty: the proof needs the opponent strong. (b) quatrain split → killed: certainty is one breath.

lines: Appearing, describing — being, and non-being its reverse —
none of it touches own-form. That essence faces the knower.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyā ca sattā yad yad asattā viparyayaḥ naitat svarūpaṃ spṛśati vastuno jñātṛgāmy adaḥ

verses.craft: Predicate catalogue hammer; end-weight knower — own-forms only address (jñātṛgāmin).
verses.rejected: (a) faces→meets → killed: L3 frozen + faces carries direction. (b) glossing own-form → killed: svarūpa load term, never glossed in song.

lines: A thing's self can never be mere object of showing-telling:
it leans on another, keeps no single form, oversteps being.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyāviṣayatāpy arthasyātmā na yujyate parāpekṣitayā naikarūpatve sattvalaṅghanāt

verses.craft: Three bars in one line — compression IS the force: leans/keeps/oversteps, three strikes one breath.
verses.rejected: (a) bars split across lines → killed: dilution. (b) unpacking naikarūpatva → killed: hyphen pressure keeps the Sanskrit pack.

lines: Granted — let no mark stand. Yet here a difference succeeds,
from appearing's coming and going — and that much serves the end.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mā bhūd viśeṣaḥ prakhyādibhāvābhāvau tataḥ punaḥ siddhyaty eva viśeṣo 'tra tāvatā ca prayojanam

verses.craft: Concession as device; prayojana→the end keeps BOUNDARY open (whose end unresolved).
verses.rejected: (a) resolving whose purpose → killed by BOUNDARY. (b) heightened diction → killed: concession is flat by design.

lines: Even so, being fits only as bound to appearing —
cut from that tie, thing and unthing stay one blur.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam apy avabhāsānuṣaktā sattocitā bhavet tadapekṣāṃ vinā bhāvābhāvayor aviśiṣṭatā

verses.craft: End-weight blur enacts aviśiṣṭatā — formlessness felt, not stated (row 10).
verses.rejected: (a) stay indistinct → killed: Latinate, unscannable; blur is vyaṅgya. (b) explaining the tie → killed: song shows, never tells.

lines: But how keep they one, when the existent performs its function,
and the other does not? — Yet the thing, in own self, stays without mark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ syād aviśeṣo 'tra yāvatārthakriyāṃ hi san kuryān nānyas tathāpy artho nirviśeṣo nijātmani

verses.craft: Both voices in one breath: objection (But how?) + containment (Yet…) — dash is the hinge (argmap: contained within the reply).
verses.rejected: (a) objection/reply split stanzas → killed: containment must happen in one breath. (b) naming Dharmakīrti → killed: imported erudition is vighna (NOTE keeps the mapping in prose, not song).

lines: Steeped in the working-shine dye, the existent would subsist
by its own form — yet differ from the non-existent nowhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam arthakriyābhāsopādhisaṃbhedam āgataḥ sann arthaḥ syāt svarūpeṇa nāsatas tu viśiṣyate

lines: But even there, no working is declared of the already-proven thing —
the two run level. So their ground stands on awareness.

lines: And were awareness ungrasping in its very form,
it too would rank with non-being, with the inert — as before.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvid apy aparāmarśarūpā cet tad asāv api abhāvena jaḍenātha tulyaiva prāgvad ātmani

verses.craft: The turn + ring: as before echoes v1s grant — no-difference now swallows bare awareness. Slowest line; sting is cold/śānta.
verses.rejected: (a) heightening (how terrible) → killed: heat is imported vighna. (b) resolving aparāmarśa past ungrasping → killed by frozen ledger.
